afe_cover.$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for an operator AFE cover letter (joint-interest owner copy). JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. Field names match truth/synth/afe_cover.json so the scorer needs no mapping. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

letter_date.description: Date printed at the top of the letter, exactly as printed (do not reformat).

operator_name.description: Name of the operator sending the letter, from the letterhead or signature block, exactly as printed.

addressee.description: Name of the working-interest owner the letter is addressed to, exactly as printed.

afe_number.description: AFE number referenced in the letter, exactly as printed including any prefix and hyphens.

well_name.description: Well name referenced in the letter, exactly as printed.

response_due_date.description: Date by which the owner must return the election, exactly as printed. Null if the letter states no due date.

wi_decimal_stated.description: The owner's working-interest decimal as printed in this letter, six decimal places. Copy the printed decimal; never convert from a percentage and never recompute.

net_share_stated.description: The owner's net dollar share of the AFE estimate as printed in this letter. Digits only, no currency symbol or thousands separators.

afe.$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for an Authorization for Expenditure (AFE). JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

afe_number.description: AFE number printed in the header, exactly as printed including prefix and hyphens.

operator_name.description: Operator name printed in the header, exactly as printed.

well_name.description: Well name printed in the header, exactly as printed.

api_number.description: API well number as printed, e.g. NN-NNN-NNNNN.

county.description: County name as printed, without the word County.

afe_type.description: Type of operation the AFE authorizes, as printed, e.g. Recompletion, Drill, Workover.

total_estimate.description: Total estimated cost as printed on the total line. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never add the cost lines yourself.

cost_lines.description: One item per printed row of the cost estimate table, in printed order. Return every printed row, including zero-dollar rows.

line_no.description: Line number printed on the row.

account_code.description: Account or AFE code printed on the row, exactly as printed.

description.description: Cost description printed on the row, exactly as printed.

category.description: The intangible or tangible grouping the row is printed under, lowercase.

amount.description: Row amount as printed. Digits only.

field_ticket.$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for a vendor field ticket (service ticket). JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. One ticket per call. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

ticket_number.description: Ticket number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

vendor_name.description: Service company issuing the ticket, exactly as printed.

well_name.description: Well or location the work was performed on, exactly as printed.

afe_number.description: AFE number written on the ticket, exactly as printed. Null if the ticket carries none.

line_items.description: One item per printed charge row of the ticket's table, in printed order. Do NOT include the Ticket total row or any subtotal row: a row whose description reads Ticket total, Total, or Subtotal is the total field, not a line item.

description.description: Charge description printed on the row, exactly as printed.

quantity.description: Quantity printed on the row. Some quantities are entered by hand in pen; read the pen entry as written and do not round it.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed on the row, exactly as printed, e.g. hour, day, bbl, each.

rate.description: Unit rate printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed rate even when it looks wrong; never substitute a rate from another row or document.

amount.description: Extended amount printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed amount; never multiply quantity by rate yourself.

total.description: Ticket total as printed. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.

customer_signature_present.description: True only if a customer or company-representative signature is actually written in the signature block. False when the block is printed but empty.

hauling_log.$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for a fluid hauling / vacuum truck log. JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

log_number.description: Log or manifest number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

hauler_name.description: Hauling company named on the log, exactly as printed.

log_date.description: Date of the log as printed.

well_name.description: Well or location fluid was hauled from, exactly as printed.

loads.description: One item per printed load row, in printed order. Return every printed row.

load_no.description: Load number printed on the row.

time.description: Time printed on the row, exactly as printed.

fluid_type.description: Fluid type printed on the row, exactly as printed.

barrels.description: Barrels printed on the row. Digits only, keeping any printed decimal.

destination.description: Disposal or delivery destination printed on the row, exactly as printed.

total_barrels.description: Total barrels as printed on the total line. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.

invoice.$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for a vendor invoice that carries field tickets behind it. JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

vendor_name.description: Vendor issuing the invoice, exactly as printed.

afe_number.description: AFE number printed on the invoice, exactly as printed. Null if absent.

well_name.description: Well or property billed, exactly as printed.

line_items.description: One item per printed invoice row, in printed order. Every row references the ticket it came from.

ticket_ref.description: Ticket number the row references, exactly as printed.

quantity.description: Quantity printed on the row. Digits only.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed on the row, exactly as printed.

rate.description: Unit rate printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed rate even when it differs from a rate you would expect.

amount.description: Extended amount printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed amount; never recompute it.

total.description: Invoice total as printed. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.

jib_statement.$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for an operator Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statement, owner copy. JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

statement_period.description: Billing period printed in the header, exactly as printed, e.g. June 2026.

operator_name.description: Operator issuing the statement, exactly as printed.

property_number.description: Operator property or lease number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

well_name.description: Well name printed in the header, exactly as printed.

owner_name.description: Billed owner name printed in the header, exactly as printed.

owner_number.description: Owner or interest number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

wi_decimal.description: The working-interest decimal printed in the statement HEADER, six decimal places. Copy the header value only; do not take it from a billing line.

lines.description: One item per printed billing row, in printed order. Return every printed row, including rows that continue onto a second page.

line_no.description: Line number printed on the row.

afe_ref.description: AFE number referenced on the row, exactly as printed. Null if the row carries none.

account_code.description: Account code printed on the row, exactly as printed.

gross_amount.description: Gross (100 percent) amount printed on the row. Digits only.

owner_decimal.description: The decimal printed on this line, six places. Copy it exactly even if it differs from the header decimal or from other lines. Never substitute the header value.

net_amount.description: Net amount billed to the owner as printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed figure; never multiply gross by a decimal yourself.

gross_total.description: Gross total as printed on the total line. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.

net_total.description: Net total billed as printed on the total line. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.
